title: Brain-Token Learning: Microstate-Based Tokenization and Multi-Scale Interaction for Long-Horizon EEG Sequence Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.24324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into dynamic brain activity, yet modeling long-horizon EEG sequences remains challenging due to their high temporal complexity, substantial variability across subjects, and the lack of biologically meaningful sequence representations. Existing tokenization strategies, such as fixed-window and patch-based representations, discretize EEG signals according to artificial temporal boundaries, which may disrupt intrinsic brain-state dynamics. In this work, we propose Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that introduces Brain Tokenization for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling. Instead of partitioning EEG signals into predefined temporal segments, Brain Tokenization represents EEG as sequences of recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens, where each token corresponds to a quasi-stable large-scale brain state with variable temporal duration. translated_title: 脑Token学习：基于微状态的分词与多尺度交互用于长时程脑电序列建模
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）为动态大脑活动提供了一个无创的观察窗口，然而由于其高度的时间复杂性、显著的个体间差异以及缺乏具有生物学意义的序列表示，长时程脑电序列的建模仍然充满挑战。现有的分词策略，如固定窗口和基于补丁（patch）的表示，依据人为设定的时间边界对脑电信号进行离散化，这可能破坏大脑固有的状态动力学。在本工作中，我们提出了脑Token学习，这是一个受神经科学启发的框架，为长时程脑电序列建模引入了脑分词方法。脑分词不再将脑电信号划分为预定义的时间片段，而是将脑电表示为由循环出现的、源自微状态的脑token组成的序列，其中每个token对应于一个具有可变时间持续时长的准稳定大尺度脑状态。基于这些具有生物学意义的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受神经科学启发的“脑Token学习”框架，将脑电信号表示为基于微状态的、时长可变的循环脑token序列，并结合多尺度交互，从而实现更符合大脑固有状态动力学的长时程脑电序列建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that tokenizes EEG into recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens with variable temporal durations and multi-scale interaction, enabling biologically meaningful long-horizon EEG sequence modeling.
